item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - BILLIE EILISH'S OFFICIAL INSTRUMENTALS
item.description:
Hi!

I've been looking for the full collection of Billie's instrumentals. I mean, on YouTube you can find them, but in most cases they are fan-made and of course to collect/download they lose a lot of quality.

I was wondering if anybody had, by any chance, all her discography's instrumentals... I found on this website the ones of HMHAS, but the other albums' are really incomplete or not lossless in some cases.

Any bonus material like hidden vocals, or collector's stuff is welcome too.

Thanks.
